nodes.norm_label: security: public firebase web config, never commit adminsdk keys

nodes.label: Exercise catalog (739 exercises, bundled)
nodes.rationale: Excludes stretches and cardio; base catalog bundled in the app, user-created exercises stored in shared Firestore 'exercises' collection.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph (query/path/explain) before raw grep/reads because it returns a much smaller subgraph than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep; run graphify update after code changes (AST-only, no API cost); graph.json is rewritten whole on each build so large diffs are expected.
